name: EventsAIR
description_en:
EventsAir is a hosted event-management platform covering registration, abstracts, speakers, logistics, attendee engagement, onsite delivery and reporting. Its integrated approach lets an event team carry the same attendee and session information through planning and event day rather than maintaining unrelated tools for each step.

Current plans distinguish a single major event, a small multi-event programme and enterprise flexibility. The page advertises broad features across plans, but event counts, users, AI allowances, payment processing and optional connectors remain separate conditions. Unlimited registrations explicitly have fair-use terms.
description_zh:
EventsAir 是托管活动管理平台，覆盖报名、摘要、讲者、物流、参与者互动、现场交付和报表，让团队把同一参与者与场次数据贯穿规划及活动日。

现行方案区分单个主要活动、小型多活动计划和企业灵活范围。虽然各方案宣传广泛功能，活动数、用户、AI 额度、支付及可选连接仍有独立条件，“不限报名”明确受合理使用条款约束。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate registration, agenda, abstracts, logistics and attendance in one platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在同一平台协调报名、议程、摘要、物流及出席。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans list app, check-in, badging, lead and engagement functions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐列有应用、签到、徽章、线索和互动功能。

en: Coordinate association conference registration, session choices and onsite records.
zh: 协调协会会议报名、场次选择与现场记录。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define major/small events, platform users and integrations, then validate a changed attendee and session across planning and onsite views.
steps.zh: 明确大小活动、用户及集成，再核对人员与场次变更贯穿规划和现场视图。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Quoted event-programme license with fair use, AI allowance, optional upgrades and payment processing.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Single, Multi and Enterprise require pricing requests. Single: one event/up to three users; Multi: up to three major events/unlimited users; smaller-event conditions and fair-use registrations apply. AI allowances vary. Domains, connectors, services, payment gateways and processing fees may add cost. Single’s user card conflicts with an unlimited-user FAQ.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Single、Multi、Enterprise 需询价。Single 为 1 个活动/最多 3 人，Multi 为最多 3 个主要活动/不限用户；小活动及报名合理使用有条件。AI 额度不同，域名、连接、服务、支付网关及处理可能另费。Single 用户卡片与不限用户 FAQ 冲突。

sources.title: Event Management Software | A Tool For All Events | EventsAir
sources.research_notes_en: Integrated event lifecycle for registration, abstracts, logistics, engagement, onsite and reporting; Air Intelligence is a separately metered inclusion.

sources.title: Event Planning Packages & Pricing | Fee Structure | EventsAir
sources.research_notes_en: Single/Multi/Enterprise event and user allowances, fair-use registrations, custom-domain/connectors/services add-ons and payment fees; FAQ user claim conflicts with Single card.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Build one path through the event lifecycle
sections.title_zh: 搭建贯穿活动生命周期的路径
sections.en: For an illustrative association conference, create registration categories, session choices and accommodation requirements, then connect them to onsite access and reports. The platform lists abstracts, speakers, meeting matching, mobile apps and virtual delivery. Verify a changed session and attendee category in every affected view; an integrated database does not remove the need to test permissions, eligibility and communication.
sections.zh: 例如协会会议，可创建报名类别、场次选择及住宿要求，再关联现场访问与报表。平台列有摘要、讲者、会面配对、应用和线上交付。应核对场次及人员类别改变后的所有相关视图；一体化数据不能代替权限、资格和通知测试。

sections.title_en: Read event and user limits beside unlimited registrations
sections.title_zh: 结合不限报名核对活动与用户上限
sections.en: Single includes one event, meetings under 100 attendees and up to three platform users. Multi lists up to three events, unlimited platform users and smaller events under 100 attendees. Enterprise is custom. The FAQ broadly says unlimited users, conflicting with the Single card; preserve the specific three-user limit pending confirmation. Registration fair use also requires the applicable agreement, not an assumption of unlimited infrastructure.
sections.zh: Single 包含 1 个活动、少于 100 人的会议及最多 3 个平台用户。Multi 列最多 3 个活动、不限平台用户，以及少于 100 人的小型活动。Enterprise 定制。FAQ 泛称用户不限，与 Single 卡片冲突，确认前应保留具体 3 人上限。报名合理使用也应核合同，不能理解为基础设施无限。

sections.title_en: Separate included features from optional delivery costs
sections.title_zh: 区分包含功能与额外交付费用
sections.en: All plans list Air Intelligence assistants with tier-based usage allowances. Custom domains, Smart Connectors, event-build services, enhanced support and additional payment gateways appear as upgrades. EventsAir Pay explicitly has extra processing fees. Thus white labelling does not automatically include a custom domain, and Open API access does not mean a ready-made paid connector is free. No public base amount was established; request a scoped quote.
sections.zh: 各套餐列 Air Intelligence 助手，但用量随层级不同。自定义域名、Smart Connectors、活动搭建、增强支持及额外支付网关列为升级；EventsAir Pay 明确另收处理费。因此白标不自动包含自有域名，Open API 也不表示付费预建连接免费。本次未确认基础金额，应按范围询价。

sections.title_zh: 规划培训与活动日异常
sections.en: EventsAir merits investigation for multi-part events with linked registration, logistics and delivery. Small standalone gatherings may require less configuration. Confirm import/export, offline check-in, badge hardware, settlement, support escalation and restoration before a live event. No source license or self-hosted package was verified. No account, payment, check-in, AI allowance or event workflow was tested here.
sections.zh: 多个环节需要关联的活动可研究 EventsAir，独立小聚会可能只需更少配置。正式活动前应确认导入导出、离线签到、徽章硬件、结算、支持升级和恢复。本次未确认源码许可或自托管服务包，也未测试账户、支付、签到、AI 额度或活动流程。

research_gaps: No registration, import/export, offline check-in, payment, AI feature or integration was tested.
Single-user conflict, fair use, AI quotas, quote amounts, hardware/add-ons, support/recovery, contract retention/residency, license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
